title: MULTILINGUAL JOINT TESTING EXERCISE: Improving Methodologies for LLM Evaluations Across Global Languages
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. The evaluation focused on multilingual safety across five harm categories: privacy, non-violent crime, violent crime, intellectual property, and robustness to jailbreaking.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as this was not a component of the study. The findings focus on the effectiveness of model safeguards, quality of refusals, and LLM-as-a-judge performance across different languages and harm categories.
